recommendation.headline: Accept the dispute and issue a full refund since the order was shipped without tracking and cannot be defended.
recommendation.rationale: The buyer filed an Item Not Received claim for a $28.00 risograph print. Because the shop shipped the order via USPS First-Class letter without a tracking number, we lack the required proof of delivery to win this dispute with PayPal. Fighting it would be futile and time-consuming, so issuing a full refund is the best course of action.

evidence.summary: The order was shipped via USPS First-Class letter with no tracking number and no carrier delivery scans.

recommendation.response_to_paypal: We have accepted the buyer's claim and issued a full refund for invoice JK-1063. The order was shipped via USPS First-Class letter without tracking, so we cannot provide proof of delivery.
risks: None, as this completely resolves the dispute.

factors.finding: The buyer never received the item (Item Not Received claim).
The order was shipped without tracking or delivery confirmation, so there is no proof of delivery to contest the claim.
The disputed amount is relatively small ($28.00).
